final_response:
We do not fully understand what consciousness is.
There is no agreed scientific theory linking brain processes to subjective experience.
Consciousness appears to be an emergent property of complex biological systems.
We lack reliable ways to measure consciousness in machines.
Designing it would require solving deep philosophical, biological, and computational problems.
